verdict.text: OTHER_REASON SIDECAR: 3 other rows, 3 sidecar entries, exact coverage, bindings match STATUS pins, every locator resolves

rederivation.path_mapping_required: The verifier was run from snapshot/files so original relative receipt paths resolved inside the snapshot. No evidence bytes were rewritten.

live_repo_dependencies.detail: The snapshot does not bundle scripts/verify-other-reasons.sh. The run used the live checkout's verifier code; an outsider needs that code at the recorded source revision or a bundled verifier artifact.
The manifest records source HEAD and spec references, but does not contain the verifier source or a content digest of the verifier itself.
STATUS, sidecar, and referenced receipts were present in the snapshot and the verdict was reached without reading their live counterparts.
The copied rerun reported source_head=no-head and still produced the same sidecar verdict. Git is needed only to contextualize source revision, not to inspect evidence bytes.

ruling: The snapshot is not cosmetic: the evidence verdict can be rerun from snapshot files alone when the verifier code is supplied separately. Exact automatic reproducibility still depends on the verifier implementation/spec revision because the manifest does not bundle or hash that code.
no_claim: No claim of fully self-contained archive reproducibility, no claim that the verifier source was snapshot-bound, and no claim that a third party can execute without obtaining the verifier implementation.
